scope: Existing LATE/SPAN, CURVED/SPAN, RULED/SPAN and DIAGNOSIS receipts only
collection_policy: Read existing JSON and path presence only. No mesh checks, hashes, new generation, receipt edits or original code changes.
iteration_note: G labels count subdivision passes. Field pass counts are separate; escape iterations are classifier iterations within a field evaluation.

late_activation_local_edge_cap_v1.name: late_activation_local_edge_cap_v1

child_rules.profile_scaling: Existing .05 angular height bend and .32 sweep wavelength scale by child span / .12; original PCHIP knots and amplitudes retained

late_activation_local_edge_cap_v1.stage_order: G1 inactive split; G2 original macro returns then inactive split; G3-G6 derived returns, reduced placement, locally capped finite field

curved_existing_CC_local_edge_cap_v1.name: curved_existing_CC_local_edge_cap_v1

child_rules.profile_scaling: Existing .05 angular height bend and .32 sweep wavelength scale by child span / .12; original PCHIP knots and amplitudes retained

curved_existing_CC_local_edge_cap_v1.stage_order: G1 CC only; G2 original returns then CC; G3-G6 derived returns, CC plus reduced components, same capped finite field
curved_existing_CC_local_edge_cap_v1.risk: CC may soften inherited strong grooves. Scalar tag cores do not lock whole faces or fold angles.
